# BladeX Education

> Educational consulting and mentorship for Myanmar students pursuing study abroad. The site also includes the BladeX AI & Technology division.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bladex-edu.vercel.app/): Overview, programs preview, and university destinations.
- [About Us](https://bladex-edu.vercel.app/About): Team profiles and mission.
- [Programs](https://bladex-edu.vercel.app/Programs): Advisory programs and services.
- [Consultants](https://bladex-edu.vercel.app/Consultants): Browse mentors by destination, field, and degree level.
- [Social Media](https://bladex-edu.vercel.app/Social): Official channels and community links.
- [BladeX AI & Technology](https://bladex-edu.vercel.app/BladeXAI): AI and technology division.

## Contact

- [Email](mailto:bladexedu@gmail.com): General inquiries.
